plugins.name: ClinePassBridge
plugins.description: 让 Cline Pass 订阅接入 CPA：支持 WorkOS 设备码账号登录与 API key 两种凭据，上报套餐、余额与 5 小时 / 7 天 / 30 天滚动窗口额度，可靠的流式与非流式转发，并内置模型映射与模型连通性测试。 / Connect Cline Pass subscriptions to CPA: sign in with a WorkOS device code or paste an API key, get plan, balance and 5-hour / 7-day / 30-day rolling windows reported to the dashboard, reliable streaming and non-streaming forwarding, plus model mapping and per-model connectivity tests in the built-in console.
